faqs.question: What is the CodeAlpha internship?
faqs.answer: CodeAlpha offers remote internship programs where interns build real projects in domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, and Data Science.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the internship?
faqs.answer: You apply through the CodeAlpha website (www.codealpha.tech) by filling in the online application form and choosing your domain.

faqs.question: Is the internship paid?
faqs.answer: The CodeAlpha internship is an unpaid, learning-focused program. You gain hands-on experience, a certificate, and project work for your portfolio.

faqs.question: Is the internship remote or on-site?
faqs.answer: The internship is fully remote and online, so you can complete it from anywhere on your own schedule.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the internship?
faqs.answer: The internship typically runs for one month, during which you complete the assigned tasks for your domain.

faqs.question: How many tasks do I need to complete?
variations: do I need to finish all tasks
faqs.answer: You must complete a minimum of two or three tasks out of the four listed for your domain. Submitting only one task is considered incomplete.

faqs.question: Will I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. On successfully completing the required tasks you receive a QR-verified completion certificate, an internship offer letter, a unique ID certificate, and a letter of recommendation based on performance.

faqs.question: How do I submit my completed task?
faqs.answer: You submit your completed task using the Submission Form shared in your respective WhatsApp group. Follow the instructions in that form carefully.

faqs.question: Where should I upload my source code?
variations: how to submit code on github
faqs.answer: Upload your complete source code to GitHub in a repository named 'CodeAlpha_ProjectName'. Include a README explaining how to run the project.

faqs.question: Do I need to post on LinkedIn?
variations: do I have to share on linkedin
faqs.answer: Yes. You are asked to share your internship status on LinkedIn, tagging @CodeAlpha, and to post a short video explanation of your project with the GitHub repo link.

faqs.question: What is the Letter of Recommendation based on?
variations: how is the recommendation letter decided
faqs.answer: The Letter of Recommendation is based on your performance during the internship, including the quality of your submitted tasks.

faqs.question: What domains can I choose from?
faqs.answer: CodeAlpha offers several domains including Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Data Science, Java Programming, Python Programming, and more.

faqs.question: What tools do I need for the AI tasks?
faqs.answer: For the AI domain you typically need Python, VS Code, Git, and libraries such as NLTK, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and music21 depending on the task.

faqs.question: Can I use any programming language?
faqs.answer: For the Artificial Intelligence tasks, Python is recommended because the suggested libraries (NLTK, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, music21) are Python-based.

faqs.question: What if I get stuck on a task?
faqs.answer: You can reach out through the WhatsApp group or contact CodeAlpha support via WhatsApp at +91 9336576683 for guidance.

faqs.question: How do I contact CodeAlpha?
faqs.answer: You can contact CodeAlpha through their website www.codealpha.tech or via WhatsApp at +91 9336576683.

faqs.question: Is the internship certificate verifiable?
faqs.answer: Yes. The completion certificate is QR-verified, so employers can scan the QR code to confirm its authenticity.

faqs.question: Do I get placement support?
variations: will you help me get a job
faqs.answer: Yes. CodeAlpha provides job opportunities and placement support as well as resume building support for interns.

faqs.question: Can I complete the internship at my own pace?
faqs.answer: The internship is self-paced and remote, but you must complete your tasks within the time frame mentioned in your offer letter.

faqs.question: What happens if I submit only one task?
faqs.answer: Submitting only one task is considered incomplete and the certificate will not be issued. Complete at least two or three tasks.
